Thanks for contributing this fix and adding the regression test!

Once merged, you can verify it before the next release by checking out the updated `main` and building the CLI with Go 1.22+:

```bash
make cli-build
./bin/agent version
```

From your deployment directory, with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` configured, run the newly built binary against a recent call:

```bash
TROUBLESHOOT_LLM_PROVIDER=anthropic \
  /path/to/new/agent rca --call CALL_ID --llm
```

Replace `CALL_ID` with your call ID. Confirm that the output includes `AI DIAGNOSIS (anthropic - claude-haiku-5-5)` followed by a diagnosis. No container rebuild or restart is required.

This fix will be included in the next release, including the prebuilt CLI binaries.
